extracted.name: Cowboy Caviar
extracted.description: Our easy Cowboy Caviar recipe has fresh, healthy ingredients and is perfect for game day or potlucks! It serves a crowd, is budget friendly, and only takes 10 minutes to make.
ingredient_lines: 15 ounce can black beans (, drained and rinsed)
15 ounce can pinto beans (, (or 2 cans if you want more bean), drained and rinsed)
instruction_lines: Combine: In a large bowl combine beans, corn, tomatoes, and onion. Stir in avocados and cilantro.
Season: Squeeze lime juice into the bowl and add a pinch of sea salt. Stir to combine. Add more sea salt, to taste. Refrigerate until ready to serve.
